_comment: svelte-check's view: the components as well as the TypeScript. It is separate from tsconfig.renderer.json because tsc cannot parse a .svelte file and errors on the glob, while svelte-check needs it — without the glob svelte-check only reaches components that TypeScript imports, so every .stories.svelte went unchecked. scripts/svelte-check.mjs proves the coverage with a standalone fixture before it trusts a clean run.
